translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Minuvu no duwon Bohok no Et-et
Na, to id potupang si Disas pomon diyot lovuntud, mo-uraan minuvu kos id tintinundug kandin.

Duwon sokkad no minuvu no duwon bohok no et-et no id porani ki Disas, woy mid lingko-od diyot isowwan din woy mid ikahi to, “Longaggon, nokosaddoo a nod poko-uli ka ka-ay't molibmit no bohok ku otik id kopi-i ru.”
Na, id somaddan ni Disas iddos minuvu woy id ikohiyan din to, “Oyya, id kopi-i ku en. Na od ko-uliyan kad.” Idda ron en, worad iddos et-et din.

Kahin Disas kandin to, “Yo ru vo id ponudtuu ini riyot ahad ondoy, ko konna, undiyon ka to tohodbuwis amoy'd po-ontong to lawa ru. Woy boggoy ka to buwis no id suhu ni Moises amoy'd posivonnaa riyot mgo minuvu no no-uliyan kad.”
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Sudsuhuwon to Kopitan to mgo Sundau
Na, to id inguma si Disas diyot Capernaum, duwon sokkad no kopitan to mgo sundau to Roma no mid porani amoy'd nganoy kandin. Kahi rin to,
“Longaggon, duwon sudsuhuwon ku no diid pokowaong woy lampas no mosakit kos od geddamon din.”
Kahin Disas kandin to, “Oyya, kuo kid me-en sud bowiyan ku sikandin.”
Piru mid tavak iddos kopitan to, “Longaggon, motuus ka koddi, de-en konna a ollog nod po-usok kikow riyot baoy ku. Osengow robbo woy od ko-uliyan en iddos sudsuhuwon ku.

Nokosaddoo a ka-ay, oyyos ahad siyak, no-iraom a to kotungud taddot mowwet pa koddi, woy duwon mandad mgo sundau no no-iraom to koddin kotungud. Otid ikahi a riyot sokkad no, ‘Ipanow kad,’ na od ipanow en sikandin. Woy otid ikahi a riyot sokkad no, ‘Undini ka,’ na od undini en sikandin. Woy otid ikohiyan ku iddos koddin uripon no, ‘Puungiyu ini,’ na od puungan din en.”

To norinog idda ni Disas, nosoobbuwan sikandin woy id osengan din iddos mgo minuvu nid tintinundug kandin, kahi rin to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no waa poron nokita ku no minuvu no duwon dakkoon kodsalig no iling ka-ay, ahad dini to Israel.

Pomotawi row! Init morin allow, mo-uraa kos od kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama no id pomon diyon tid tollak woy pomon diyon tid saop, woy od unsad sikandan amoy'd ka-an duma ongki Abraham, ki Isaac woy ki Jacob.

Piru iddos koubbaran ni Israel no sikandan en nanoy kos od kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama, id lumbag diyot mosuksukirom. Na rutun, mopet dobbo kos sinoggawon dan woy'd pogkihot sikandan to ngipon pomon to mosakit nod geddamon dan.”
Na mid ikahi si Disas diyot kopitan to, “Uli kad bo, su notuman don iddos id pomokayan du.” Idda ron en, no-uliyan don iddos sudsuhuwon to kopitan.
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Mo-uraan Novohokan
Na, mid undiyon si Disas to baoy ni Pedro. To kod-inguma rin dutun, nokita rin iddos ba-ay no onuhang ni Pedro no id oilogga su id momonit.
Id somaddan ni Disas kos bollad din woy idda ron en, no-uliyan sikandin. Na, mid onnow sikandin woy id sondad to koka-an atag ki Disas.

To od kosagkup don, id piyod to mgo minuvu riyot ki Disas iddos mo-uraan id losuran to busow woy dos nongovohokan. To kodsuhu rin da en, mid leggua iddos mgo busow woy no-uliyan dos langun no novohokan.
Notomanan ini, su amoy od kotuman iddos id po-ikahi to Monama ki propeta Isaias no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Sikandin en kos id awa to od ponggeddamon to lawa ta, woy sikandin kos id awa to mgo bohok ta.”

content: Dos Kodti-is to Kosupittan Pomon to Koddumoruma ki Disas
Na, to nokita ni Disas iddos mo-uraan minuvu no id lolivuung diyot kandin, mid ikahi sikandin diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Od undiyon ki to dipaat lanow.”
Piru to waa pa sikandan noko-ipanow, duwon sokkad no tohodnonaw to mgo Suhu ni Moises no id porani ki Disas woy mid ikahi to, “Tohodnonaw, od duma a kikow ahad ingkon ka od undiyon.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Moppiya pa kos mgo lokivot su duwon od ko-ubpan, woy dos mgo manuk su duwon saag. Piru siyak no Anak to Minuvu, waa en noto-oo nod ko-imooyyan ku.”
Na, duwon mandad sokkad taddot od pondumoruma kandin no mid ikahi to, “Longaggon, od uli a pa, woy otik nolobbong don iddos amoy ku, od duma a kikow.”
Piru kahin Disas kandin to, “Podtohonowd iddos minatoy no od lobbong
taddot mgo minuvu no waa umuun waad tomanon. Piru sikkow, duma ka koddi.”
Dos Kodposoro ni Disas to Kaamag woy Baud
Na, id sakoy si Disas to bollangay woy mid duma kandin iddos mgo tinodduwan din.
Tigkow id doppot kos monokkaan kaamag, woy id lapow ron kos mgo baud diyot bollangay, de-en asow ran don od koonnod. Piru si Disas, nokotintinuhon.
Na, id porani iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy id sukaa ran sikandin, kahi ran to, “Longaggon, tovangi koy! Od koonnod kid man moho ini!”

Mid tavak si Disas to, “Mambot od kovaakkan kow? Oray'n disok kos kopomakoy row!” Na, id lohinat sikandin woy id sugga rin iddos kaamag woy mgo baud amoy'd soro, woy idda ron en, id tivonok kos langun.
Oray'n nosoobbuwan iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy id po-ikohiyoy ran to, “Ondoy moho inin minuvu no ahad iddos kaamag woy mgo baud, id dumoruma kandin?”
Dos Kodpoleggua ni Disas to mgo Busow riyot Oruwon Minuvu

Na, id ponayun onsi Disas taman to id inguma ran diyot dipaa to lanow no riyot lugaa to mgo toho Gadara. To kodponog din, mid sinuggung kandin iddos oruwon minuvu no id losuran to mgo busow. Id pomon sikandan diyot langub nod lovongngan woy oraroy ran no movuut, de-en waa od poko-ukit taddon lugaa.
Tigkow sikandan id pomehes, kahi ran to, “Sikkow no Anak to Monama, ondan man kos lavut du konami? Od silutan koy vo nikkow ahad konna pa ini kos ollog no timpu?”
Na konna oray'n moriyu rutun, duwon mo-uraan bavuy nid ponuwaa.
De-en id po-eru-eru ki Disas iddos mgo busow, kahi ran to, “Otid po-owan koy nikkow, po-olina koy nod lasud duwot mgo bavuy.”
Na kahin Disas to, “Diyon kowd!” De-en id ponleggua iddos mgo busow woy id losuran dan iddos mgo bavuy. Idda ron en, id pouharus diyot daama iddos mgo bavuy woy nongo-uug diyot lanow woy nongoonnod.
To nokita idda taddot mgo tohodtamong to mgo bavuy, id lungkossu ran po-undiyot bonuwa, woy id ponudtuu ran iddos langun no notomanan taddot oruwon minuvu nid losuran to mgo busow.
Purisu iddos langun no minuvu nid oubpa taddon bonuwa, id undiyot ki Disas, woy id po-eru-eru ran nod awa sikandin diyot lugaa ran.

footnotes.text: Diyot botasanon to mgo Judio, od temosson dan iddos tullan taddot id patoy to sokkad don no lahun sasang to ugkas din, idda pa id dollondollon dan don id lobbong.
